summary: Nothing is left to implement: the spawn-claim race fix is already on master. Commit 3fffd89adf (PR #85, 'GymBotArea: spawn only after the server accepts the spawn claim, so simultaneous presses spawn one bot') changes GymBotArea.cs and the two multiplayer guides exactly as the previous session's commit on this branch does. The diff between origin/master and this branch for those files is empty. The fix uses a transactional StringKeyDictionary insert, as Nisan asked: the server accepts one client's claim and rejects the other, so only one bot spawns. Its commit message says it was tested with two players in MPPM (5 synchronized double presses, 1 bot each). The request ('@Big Sys Merge and mark as done') asks a human to merge and close the card; this session cannot merge or change card status, so no code was changed and no PR was opened.
